task: FAL-279 (slice A of the FAL-271 art audit)
method: Edit the shipped image, never draw fresh. One shipped frame is the anchor; each other frame is a qwen21_edit "change only its legs and feet" edit of the anchor (prep_walk_frame.py: padded, 3x). The two down frames then get a small CPU swing of the scarf ends / cape hem / antennae (swing_part.py: the shipped pixels sheared a few degrees from their root, no redraw). finish_walk.py registers each frame to the anchor on the head and stands the lowest foot on the anchor ground row; pack_source.py lays the rows out for build-assets.mjs. Old sources owlet-walk.png and mothkin-walk.png are kept and marked skip in tools/assets/sheets.json.
why_cpu_swing: A qwen21_edit "change only the scarf ends / cape / antennae" round (FAL-279 round 2, seeds 27903-27904, 16 renders) redrew the part instead of moving it: antennae shrank or changed shape, scarf ends came out thin and flat. In a 6-frame loop that reads as the part popping, so the swing is done on the CPU from the shipped pixels.
measured: head_track.py on the built webp: head bob owlet-boy 2.0 %, owlet-girl 2.0 %, mothkin-boy 2.2 %, mothkin-girl 2.4 %; head scale 1.00 on every frame; ground row within 1 px.

frames.label: walk-down-v2
frames.prompt: This is an RGBA format image with transparency. Edit <image1>, a little owl walking to the right. Change only its legs and feet, so that both feet are flat on the ground under the body: the front leg (on the right) is bent at the knee and takes the weight, and the back foot (on the left) is a short step behind with its heel just lifting. Both legs look exactly like the legs in <image1>: the same golden-orange colour, the same scaly texture with soft shading, dark brown outlines and small dark claws. Both legs are the same colour. Keep the head, the big yellow eyes, the beak, the ear tufts, the red knitted scarf, the brown satchel, the wings and the body exactly as they are, in the same place, the same size. The bird still faces right. The lowest foot stands on the same ground line as in <image1>. Change nothing else. Same painted style, same dark outlines. No ground, no shadow, no motion lines, no text. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.
